review_notes: I read the whole file. I did not read other source files or look up any API. I checked these repeated patterns: (1) `re_sq_le_nrd` and `eq_zero_of_nrd_eq_zero` both prove the same three nonnegativity facts for the terms of `nrd`. (2) `nrd_sub_one` and `nrd_add_one` have near-identical 4-line proofs. (3) The three `pow_*_of` lemmas share a short calculation. (4) The `m = -2` and `m = 2` branches of `pow_twelve_eq_one` mirror each other. (5) `hxu` in `not_dvd_card` and `invFun` in `unitEquiv` build the same `IsUnitOf` tuple. Each of these repeats only short calculations or routine term construction. The rubric says those are insufficient. A shared lemma would save little and would need its own statement and hypotheses, so I did not report any of them. The one remaining uncertainty is whether a unified lemma for the `nrd_add_one` / `nrd_sub_one` pair, or for the nonnegativity facts, would be worth adding. I judged it marginal.
